description: This Kotlin source file defines a ViewModel class for managing note details within an Android application. It handles loading and deleting individual notes, interacting with a repository and database, and exposing state flows for UI binding.

classes.name: NoteDetailViewModel
classes.description: A ViewModel class managing the UI data for note details, allowing load and delete operations on notes.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads a note by its ID and updates the observable state flow.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a note by its ID and executes a callback upon completion.
